entities.name: Republic
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: A system of government in which power is held by elected representatives, pioneered by Rome from 509 BCE. The Roman Republic's institutions — Senate, consuls, tribunes — influenced all subsequent republican and constitutional governments.
